title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.
